# Music with Pat

> Music with Pat is a home-based piano, violin, and music theory teaching studio in Tengah, Singapore, run by Patricia ("Ms Pat"). Patricia has 10+ years of experience teaching children from age 4 and up, and holds a Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education with Music Education. Lessons are in person only — at her quiet Tengah home studio or via home visits across west Singapore. She prepares students for ABRSM piano, violin, and theory examinations and for Direct School Admission (DSA) music auditions.

## Key facts (for direct answers)

- **Teacher:** Patricia ("Ms Pat") — 10+ years teaching experience; Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education with Music Education (a child-development credential most music-school chains do not have).
- **What she teaches:** Piano, violin, and music theory. Beginners (from age 4) through ABRSM examination grades 1–8. Adult beginners welcome.
- **Teaching approach:** Gentle, patient, encouraging, one-to-one. Each session blends practical playing, sight-reading, ear training, and music theory. Specialises in starting young children (age 4+) on ABRSM from an early-childhood-development foundation.
- **Format:** In person only — at the Tengah home studio, or home visits. No online / video-call lessons.
- **Location:** Home studio in Tengah, Singapore (next to Bukit Gombak). Serves west Singapore.
- **Areas served:** Tengah, Bukit Gombak, Bukit Batok, Choa Chu Kang, Jurong West, Jurong East, Yew Tee, Keat Hong, Lakeside, Boon Lay, Chinese Garden, Clementi, Bukit Timah, Bukit Panjang, Hillview.
- **Specialisms:** ABRSM piano/violin/theory preparation; DSA (Direct School Admission) music audition preparation; first-time young beginners.
- **Contact:** WhatsApp / phone +65 8389 8853 · https://www.musicwithpat.com/
- **In the press:** Patricia was featured in Stomp discussing the pressure on Singapore parents around ABRSM grades and DSA.

## About

- [About Patricia — Music with Pat](https://www.musicwithpat.com/about/): Patricia's background, her Bachelor's in Early Childhood Education with Music Education, teaching philosophy, and the Tengah home studio.

## Lessons

- [Children's Piano Lessons](https://www.musicwithpat.com/childrens-piano-lessons/): One-to-one piano lessons for children from age 4, built around how young children actually learn.
- [Adult Piano Lessons](https://www.musicwithpat.com/adult-piano-lessons/): Piano lessons for adult beginners and returners in west Singapore — no pressure, start from scratch.
- [Adult Violin Lessons](https://www.musicwithpat.com/adult-violin-lessons/): Violin lessons for adult beginners, drawing on the Suzuki method and the ABRSM violin syllabus.
- [DSA Piano Lessons](https://www.musicwithpat.com/dsa-piano-lessons/): Direct School Admission music audition preparation — repertoire selection, portfolio building, and mock auditions.
- [Piano Teacher Singapore](https://www.musicwithpat.com/piano-teacher-singapore/): Overview of Patricia's piano teaching across Singapore.
- [Violin Teacher Singapore](https://www.musicwithpat.com/violin-teacher-singapore/): Overview of Patricia's violin teaching.
- [Music Theory Lessons](https://www.musicwithpat.com/music-theory-lessons-singapore/): ABRSM music theory tuition, grades 1–8, alongside practical lessons.

## Guides (written by the teacher)

- [ABRSM Piano Exams in Singapore: A Parent's Guide](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/abrsm-piano-exams-singapore-guide/): Grades, fees, preparation timeline, and what to expect on exam day.
- [ABRSM vs Trinity: Which Exam Board for Your Child?](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/abrsm-vs-trinity-piano-exam-board-singapore/): How the two piano exam boards differ and which suits your child.
- [How to Prepare for Your ABRSM Piano Exam in Singapore](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/how-to-prepare-abrsm-piano-exam-singapore/): A practical, component-by-component preparation timeline.
- [Why Music Theory Matters for Young Pianists](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/why-music-theory-matters-young-pianists/): Why theory helps young pianists play better and progress faster.
- [Preparing Your Child for ABRSM Violin Exams in Singapore](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/preparing-child-abrsm-violin-exam/): ABRSM violin grades, what examiners look for, and how to support your child.
- [Is It Ever Too Late to Learn Piano as an Adult in Singapore?](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/is-it-too-late-to-learn-piano-adults-singapore/): A teacher's honest answer for adult beginners.
- [What Age Should My Child Start Piano Lessons?](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/what-age-start-piano-lessons/): Why ages 4–6 is ideal and how to spot readiness.
- [The Piano 'Arms Race' in Singapore — Patricia's Take on DSA and Exams](https://www.musicwithpat.com/blog/piano-dsa-arms-race-singapore/): Patricia's fuller perspective (as featured in Stomp) on DSA and exam pressure.
